BackstoryDef.title: Orchard child
BackstoryDef.description: Raised among orchards, grain fields, and vineyards, they rarely knew the hunger common to poorer corners of Westeros.

BackstoryDef.title: Highgarden forge apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: Their master produced tools, horseshoes, and ornamental work for a prosperous farming region.

BackstoryDef.title: Harvest laborer's child
BackstoryDef.description: Their family moved wherever strong hands were needed, from harvest fields to barns and village construction.

BackstoryDef.title: Garland maker
BackstoryDef.description: Flowers, ribbons, and decorations for festivals taught them that beauty could be a trade of its own.

BackstoryDef.title: Ward of a Reach House
BackstoryDef.description: They grew up amid feasts, tournaments, marriages, and the carefully polished rivalries of Reach nobility.

BackstoryDef.title: Heir of the Green Fields
BackstoryDef.description: Tutors prepared them to rule fertile lands where successful management mattered as much as military strength.

BackstoryDef.title: Second son of the Reach
BackstoryDef.description: Without an inheritance guaranteed, they sought glory through horsemanship, tournaments, and knightly service.

BackstoryDef.title: Flowers-born bastard
BackstoryDef.description: Known by the bastard surname Flowers, they learned to move between the lively world of servants and the glittering world of nobles.

BackstoryDef.title: Young falconer
BackstoryDef.description: They raised hawks for hunting parties held across the rich estates of the Reach.

BackstoryDef.title: Tourney page
BackstoryDef.description: They carried lances and shields for knights whose tournament injuries taught them that pageantry could still break bones.

BackstoryDef.title: Reach vintner
BackstoryDef.description: Years among vines, orchards, and cellars taught them to turn the Reach's abundance into profitable food and drink.

BackstoryDef.title: Master armorer
BackstoryDef.description: They produced polished arms and armor for knights who cared almost as much about appearance as protection.

BackstoryDef.title: Estate builder
BackstoryDef.description: Wealthy estates kept them employed building barns, halls, walls, bridges, and tournament stands.

BackstoryDef.title: Noble huntsman
BackstoryDef.description: They organized hunts through prosperous woodland and managed the hounds and horses of wealthy patrons.

BackstoryDef.title: Court minstrel
BackstoryDef.description: Their songs of love, chivalry, and famous knights earned a place at feasts throughout the Reach.

BackstoryDef.title: Herbwife of the Mander
BackstoryDef.description: The fertile Reach provided them with an abundance of medicinal herbs and patients willing to pay for remedies.

BackstoryDef.title: Oldtown scholar
BackstoryDef.description: Living in the shadow of the Citadel exposed them to books, learned debates, and knowledge rarely available elsewhere.

BackstoryDef.title: Reach knight
BackstoryDef.description: They lived for cavalry charges, tournaments, and the elaborate martial traditions of southern chivalry.

BackstoryDef.title: Estate steward
BackstoryDef.description: They managed tenants, grain stores, vineyards, servants, and the complicated finances of a wealthy estate.

BackstoryDef.title: Highgarden courtier
BackstoryDef.description: They mastered compliments, appearances, marriages, and the soft power hidden behind songs and flowers.
